symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1821: `use building block PlatformDesignSystem.Button (action: call microflow M.Act) as b_` failed with 'action override supplied, but the block has no button to rebind', on every PlatformDesignSystem block (Marketplace 44.4.0, Mendix 11.12.6, mxcli v0.31.0).
cause: The action override's target predicate isButtonWidget matched only the built-in button types (actionbutton, linkbutton, button). The PDS blocks are built from the pluggable pdsbutton, so no widget matched, although the engine already writes a pluggable widget's on-click slot from the same Action property the override sets.
file: mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3.go (isPluggableButtonWidget, the ActionOverride branch of the building-block expansion)
insight: A pluggable widget is a button target when its definition names it a button AND maps a slot to OnClick. The click slot alone is not enough: a Gallery and a Data grid 2 take OnClick for a row click and a PDS Link for a link click, and on a PDS page header the first clickable widget is the 'Back to' link, not the primary button. With no project there is no registry, and only the built-in types match, as before.
